_meta.description: Five accepted baseline-success seed/instruction pairs for controlled RoboTwin imagination-reward validation.

instructions: Grab the beige coffee mug, turn it, set it on the table, then hang it on the medium-sized rack.
Pick up the ceramic mug, rotate it, place it on the table, and hang it on the rack with straight and slanted rods.
Pick the matte black mug from the table, rotate it, place it in the middle, and hang it onto the medium-sized rack.
Grab the red can with white top, drop it into the medium basket with smooth texture, lift the medium basket with smooth texture with another arm.
Grab the cylindrical can with bright colors and put it in the basket with rounded edges, then lift the basket with rounded edges.
